title: Mask Adoption Behavior Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes within a population under the influence of social networks, policies, enforcement, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe and interact with social neighbors; observed mask-wearing and shared opinions shift an individual's belief and adoption.

interactions.name: household_influence
interactions.description: Household norms and resource sharing affect members' mask adoption and ability to procure masks.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast
interactions.description: Authority announces recommendations or mandates; messages affect risk perception, beliefs, and compliance propensity.

interactions.name: venue_enforcement
interactions.description: Venues with mask policies check compliance and may deny entry or trigger fines via Authority.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: Media outlets broadcast messages that influence beliefs, risk perception, and trust.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People attempt to buy masks from retailers; purchase success depends on stock and price.

interactions.name: norm_cues_in_venues
interactions.description: Visible compliance rates in venues provide normative cues that influence subsequent adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until the population first reaches 70% mask adoption.

metrics.name: post_mandate_sustained_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption rate in the 30 days after a mandate ends.

metrics.name: venue_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Average rate of compliance with venue mask policies among visitors.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_by_income
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between highest and lowest income groups (or inequality index).

metrics.name: fines_issued
metrics.description: Total number (or value) of fines issued due to non-compliance.

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Number of days with at least one retailer experiencing a mask stockout.

metrics.name: average_trust_in_authority
metrics.description: Mean trust in authority across the population over time.

metrics.name: message_sentiment_balance
metrics.description: Net balance of pro-mask versus anti-mask messages seen by agents.
